case_number: Contempt Petition(Civil) No(s).......of 2024 (D. No. 1106 of 2024) in Special Leave Petition(Crl.) No(s). 14489 of 2023

parties.respondent: Kamal Dayani & Ors. / State Of Gujarat

summary: Contempt petition challenging willful disobedience of Supreme Court's interim anticipatory bail order dated 8th December 2023; Magistrate's custody remand granted despite Supreme Court's ad interim bail granting liberty to serve notice through Standing Counsel; standard: willful disobedience of court order; reasoning: Magistrate erred in interpreting Supreme Court's order allowing remand; court held that remand was contrary to SC's direction for cooperation in investigation without arrest; issue: whether police custody remand was authorized given SC's bail conditions.
final_judgment: Contempt petition allowed; Magistrate's remand order set aside; investigation to proceed under parameters of Supreme Court's interim bail order; respondents directed to comply strictly with SC's directions.
